label: .notBuiltAvailable: the dry run's notBuilt is ignored, so a command FlareCore hasn't built reads available
find: if let error = copy.layerError, case .command(.notBuilt) = error { return .unavailable(error.message) }

label: .overrideWins: the probe's schema is used where an override exists
an enum payload loses its cases: Easing's probe sample no longer decodes
find: if case .object(let fields)? = cases.first?.json, let properties = fields["properties"] { first = properties }

label: the undo step keeps "Undo ", so outcomes name the menu title, not the step
notDrawnOnStage is ignored: mask and matte commands read available though the stage can't draw them
lastFrameFits: a key moved to the scene's length is taken, one frame past its end
find: guard move.to >= length else { return nil }
replace: guard move.to > length else { return nil }

label: moveUnchecked: keyframe.move goes to the engine unchecked, so a key lands past the scene
find: if let move = command as? MoveKeyframe, let why = outsideOwner(move) { throw .failed(id: id, message: why) }
